meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 当用户提出重构、清理或简化代码时,Claude 会先确认目标,再分析整个代码库,找出相关依赖,评估测试覆盖,制定分步计划;随后逐步修改,每步都运行测试,失败立即回退,最后做全项目回归并输出改动总结。
howto.when: 当用户说“refactor、restructure、cleanup”等关键词,或输入 /refactor 命令时触发;若请求含糊(如“改进代码”),它先追问具体目标。

say.text: 重构 src/auth/handler.ts,把验证逻辑拆成独立模块。
say.note: Claude 会先分析相关代码与测试再动手。

say.text: /refactor 把所有用旧 API 的调用改成新接口。
say.note: 它会先定位所有受影响的文件。

say.text: 用保守策略重构整个项目,保持行为不变。
say.note: 会先评估测试覆盖,再开始重构。

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor, Claude clarifies the target, maps the codebase and test coverage, plans, then executes small verified steps with rollback, ending with a full regression check and a change summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says keywords like 'refactor', 'restructure', 'cleanup', or uses the /refactor command. Vague requests (e.g., 'improve code') are met with clarifying questions.

say_en.text: Refactor src/auth/handler.ts and extract the validation logic into a separate module.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes related code and tests before editing.

say_en.text: /refactor migrate all callers of the deprecated API to the new interface.
say_en.note: It finds all affected files first.

say_en.text: Refactor the whole project with a conservative strategy, keeping behavior unchanged.
